accentPalettes.storage: one shared preset per space in space.yml, owner-written through PATCH /api/spaces/{space}; the v0.4 browser-local key seeds it once, then is deleted
accentPalettes.contrastFloor: 4.5:1 accent-on-ground, ink-on-accent, body ink and metadata ink on the composited 12% wash over ground, inset, surface and raised, and body/muted text on the glass composite over the lightest gradient stop, in both schemes, enforced by web/src/lib/accent.test.ts

surfaces.shell: A floating glass header inset from the top and sides, 64px tall, rounded 20px, sticky; a glass rail card at lg; a 68px glass dock on a phone with the space destination, a 56px accent capture circle and search.
surfaces.spaceCover: A masthead (56px glass icon tile, display name, factual summary line, two pill actions) above a matte 22px card holding the keyed type ledger, with a glass activity card in the 4/12 margin at xl, a matte graph card under the body and a colophon line.
surfaces.recordSheet: One matte 24px card: identity band, schedule strip, body, links and history. The 4/12 property margin is a left-ruled column at xl, a top-ruled block below, never a second card. A clean Saved seal is a glass pill; a dirty record sticks a glass save row above the dock on a phone and saves from the identity band at lg.
surfaces.ledgerTable: A 20px matte card clips a table with two fills: a raised band across the whole header row and the card surface for every body cell, pinned columns included. A header label is muted at rest and ink when sorted; the accent marks the sorted arrow, the active row and the selection, never the column label. The title column stays pinned. Select, multi-select, relation and recurrence cells open one floating editor: a glass-strong popover anchored to the cell at a fine pointer, the sheet on a phone, with a one-line chip left in the cell. View tabs are a segmented pill; filter and sort triggers are pills; their panels are glass.
surfaces.overlays: Sheets and the command palette are glass-strong at 28px over a blurred scrim; menus and toasts are glass-strong at 18px; close controls are circles on the handed edge.
surfaces.quietSurfaces: Schema, members, settings, trash, auth and account settings share one page header and matte 22px section cards; the danger section carries an Ember edge; auth is a glass top bar, the form, and a glass margin panel.

display.purpose: Space name, auth and page titles; Maple Mono 36/1.05 with -0.03em, 30/1.08 on a phone, ligatures off.

title.purpose: Record title and type page name; Maple Mono 26/1.1 with -0.02em, 22/1.15 on a phone.

body.purpose: Prose, form values and row names; IBM Plex Sans 15/1.6.

label.purpose: Column headers, field labels, roles and keys; uppercase Maple Mono 11/1.5, 0.09em.

small.purpose: Secondary rows, hints, metadata sentences and errors; IBM Plex Sans 13/1.5.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: One ambient shadow on every glass panel. Light: 0 20px 44px -24px rgba(40,44,34,0.28).

shadows.name: dock
shadows.purpose: The phone dock only; it sits closer to the thumb and needs a tighter throw.

shadows.name: accent-action
shadows.purpose: The primary pill and the capture circle; never a zero-offset halo.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: One exponential ease-out for every entrance and state transition.

motion.name: fast
motion.purpose: Result changes, hover colour and palette result entrance.

motion.name: slow
motion.purpose: The one page-content settle and the sheet rise.

motion.name: settle
motion.purpose: One entrance on a page's main content; fill-mode backwards so a fixed descendant is never trapped in a wrapper; removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: sheet
motion.purpose: One entrance for every overlay. The panel lands opaque so its glass is live in the first frame — an opacity fade would defer the frosted face; static under prefers-reduced-motion.

chrome.material: frosted glass chrome over a top-lit ground
surfaces: app header: glass at 55%, blur 24px, saturate 150%, 20px radius, inset 8-12px
desktop space rail: glass at 55%, 22px radius, sticky under the header
phone dock: glass pill at 68px, 12px above the home indicator; 44px destinations with a 32px icon seal and one 56px accent capture circle
sheets and dialogs: glass-strong at 62%, 28px radius, blur 20px, transparent scrim with a 5px blur and brightness 0.9 (0.96 light), no fill
command palette, menus, toasts, save row, bulk bar: glass or glass-strong with one lit edge
chrome.rule: Glass is chrome only. Tables, record bodies, property grids and forms stay opaque. One lit edge plus one ambient shadow; data cards declare one hairline and no shadow.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one stateful action on a view. A full pill with the accent fill and a soft neutral drop.

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action on a translucent raised fill with a field edge.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:var(--control-standard,40px);padding:10px 16px;border:1px solid var(--color-line-interactive,#6a746a);border-radius:999px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--color-raised,#1d231e) 40%,transparent);color:var(--color-ink,#edf1e8);font:500 13px var(--font-sans);cursor:pointer;transition:background-color var(--duration-fast,120ms) var(--ease-out),border-color var(--duration-fast,120ms) var(--ease-out)}.ds-btn-ghost:hover{background:var(--color-raised);border-color:var(--color-line-strong)}.ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-accent);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Borderless action in a dense row or overlay footer; only its glyph or word at rest.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:var(--control-standard,40px);padding:10px 16px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:999px;background:transparent;color:var(--color-muted,#a2ab9f);font:500 13px var(--font-sans);cursor:pointer;transition:background-color var(--duration-fast,120ms) var(--ease-out),color var(--duration-fast,120ms) var(--ease-out)}.ds-btn-quiet:hover{background:var(--color-raised);color:var(--color-ink)}.ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-accent);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: A destructive action whose label names the loss; Ember text and edge, never a filled red.

components.name: Primitive States
components.description: Hover, focus-visible, active, selected, disabled, loading, error and read-only are defined once in components/ui/controls.tsx. Focus is a 2px accent outline at 3px offset; errors are Ember border plus a role=alert message.

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Labeled input with hint and error slots. 12px corners, translucent raised fill, accent focus ring at 3px offset.
components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:8px;font-family:var(--font-sans)}.ds-field-label{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:11px;line-height:1.5;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.09em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--color-muted)}.ds-input{height:var(--field-fine,40px);padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--color-line-interactive,#6a746a) 70%,transparent);border-radius:12px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--color-raised,#1d231e) 40%,transparent);color:var(--color-ink);font:400 15px var(--font-sans);transition:border-color var(--duration-fast,120ms) var(--ease-out)}.ds-input:hover{border-color:var(--color-line-strong)}.ds-input:focus{outline:2px solid var(--color-accent);outline-offset:3px;border-color:var(--color-accent)}.ds-input::placeholder{color:var(--color-faint)}

narrative.overview: A field guide read through a lit instrument. The chrome — header, rail, dock, sheets, menus, palette, save state — floats as frosted glass over a top-lit green-black ground. Data stays on matte, opaque cards: the space ledger, the record sheet, the table, the property grid and every form. One shared accent marks state; the capture circle is the only saturated chrome.
keyCharacteristics: A top-lit ground: #141c16 at the top edge to #0a0e0b and #070a08.
Glass at 55% (chrome) and 62% (sheets), 18-24px blur, saturate 150-160%, one lit edge and one ambient shadow.
Matte 18-24px cards for every data surface; hairline borders only, no shadow.
Pills for actions and segments, circles for icon actions, 12/18/28px corners for fields, cards and sheets.
The 68px dock with 44px destinations and one 56px accent capture circle; 40px icon circles in the header and rail.
Maple Mono display and data, IBM Plex Sans sentences; one accent per space, Lichen by default.

rules.name: The Glass Is Chrome Rule
rules.body: Glass is allowed on navigation, headers, toolbars, overlays, menus, toasts and floating actions. It is never the ground of a table cell, a record body, a property grid, a form or prose. A surface that holds data is opaque.

rules.name: The Scrim Is Not a Colour Rule
rules.body: An overlay scrim is the page itself, blurred and slightly dimmed. It never adds a coloured wash; a tint over the green ground reads as a flat plate.

rules.name: The One Light Rule
rules.body: The radial wash exists so the glass has something to refract. It is the only gradient in the product; components never add a second one.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: The shared accent marks state and one primary action. It never fills large areas and never appears twice in a row for two meanings. The 12% wash is the only tint; at full strength the accent is text, a glyph or the capture circle.

rules.name: The Radius Family Rule
rules.body: Pills for actions, segments, chips, the dock and status seals; 12px for fields; 18-24px for cards and the record; 28px for sheets. One control never mixes corners.

rules.name: The Edge or the Cards Rule
rules.body: A matte card declares one hairline and no shadow. A glass panel declares one lit edge and one ambient shadow. Never both a wide shadow and a drawn border on the same matte surface.

rules.name: The Light Is the Same Instrument Rule
rules.body: Light mode swaps the ground to bone, the glass to white and darkens the accent; it keeps every radius, type role, rule and composition.

rules.name: Every State Is Visible Rule
rules.body: Hover, focus-visible, active, selected, disabled, loading, empty, error and read-only are defined once in the UI primitives. A control with no focus-visible replacement is a defect.

dos: Float the chrome and keep the data still.
Use one accent for state and one saturated capture circle.
Use ellipses and cards with a single hairline for data.
Keep the 44px coarse target and the 16px coarse input.
Keep reading order fixed and mirror only thumb actions.
donts: Do not blur a table, a record body, a property grid, a form or prose.
Do not nest a card or a glass panel inside another.
Do not add a second accent, a component gradient, a neon glow or a decorative halo.
Do not use glass to avoid choosing a layout.
Do not animate layout, tables or prose.
Do not turn the product into a travel app with photographic covers or mascots.
